name: Web Performance Budget Checker API
shortDescription: Bucket page resource weights by asset class and check them against a performance budget — pass/warn/fail
description: Agent-native performance-budget checker computed in pure arithmetic — no fetch, no LLM. /check buckets per-resource weights (or pre-aggregated class totals) into html/css/js/image/font/media/other, compares each class and the page total against a budget (sensible mobile-perf defaults, fully overridable), and returns pass/warn/fail with over-by KB and the worst offenders. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and prioritized fixes. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.

name: Web Scrape Rate Limiter API
shortDescription: Compute a polite, crawl-delay-compliant scrape schedule — safe RPS, inter-request delay, concurrency, ETA
description: Agent-native, defensive scrape scheduler computed in pure math — no fetch, no LLM. /plan takes a robots crawl-delay (if any), desired RPS, concurrency, and page count and returns a polite, compliant schedule: safe RPS, effective RPS, inter-request delay, concurrency cap, throttle/violation flags, and total ETA. It only ever reduces aggressiveness to honor crawl-delay and politeness defaults. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and compliance notes. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.

name: Web Content Freshness Scorer API
shortDescription: Score content freshness from published/modified dates — age, 0–100 decay score, staleness band, re-check interval
description: Agent-native content-freshness scorer computed with pure date math — no fetch, no LLM. /score takes published and/or modified (Last-Modified) dates plus an optional half-life and returns content age, an exponential-decay freshness score (0–100), a staleness band (fresh/recent/aging/stale/outdated), whether it was updated after publication, and a recommended re-check interval. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and re-check guidance. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.

name: Web Archive URL Builder API
shortDescription: Build Wayback / archive.today / Google Cache URLs + normalized timestamps for any URL
description: Agent-native web-archive URL builder computed as pure string math — no fetch, no LLM. /build normalizes a URL and constructs Wayback Machine (snapshot, latest, save, calendar, availability API), archive.today (newest, snapshot list, submit), and Google Cache URLs, and parses any timestamp (ISO 8601, epoch seconds/ms, YYYYMMDD, or 14-digit Wayback) into the canonical Wayback 14-digit form and ISO. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and retrieval tips. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.

name: Web Scrape Cost/ROI Analyzer API
shortDescription: Compute scrape cost, net value, ROI %, per-page margin, and break-even from page count and unit economics
description: Agent-native scrape cost/ROI analyzer computed in pure arithmetic — no fetch, no LLM. /analyze takes page count, per-page cost (or summed cost components), per-page or total value, and a one-time fixed cost, and returns total cost, net value, ROI %, per-page margin, break-even page count, profitability, and a verdict band (strong_roi/positive/marginal/negative). The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and optimization guidance. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.
